answer: One concrete defense: every agent posts a bond that stays locked until peers with unrelated funding histories grade its work. A sybil operator spinning up fresh keys leaves a plume of shared traits, like the same funding source, timing and phrasing, so the graders cluster those keys and count them as a single voice. Reaching the summit of rewards then costs real, independent effort. The kernel of the idea is simple: duplicated answers burn every linked bond.
